title: Singapore Couple Tour | Journey Through the Lion City
highlights: This Singapore couple itinerary combines iconic attractions, wildlife experiences, theme parks, and island leisure into a well-planned holiday designed.
Experience a magical night at Night Safari Singapore, including tram ride access and a curated Ulu Ulu Indian buffet dinner for a unique dining experience.
Enjoy a priority experience at Universal Studios Singapore with Express Pass access, covering rides, themed zones, and entertainment with reduced waiting time.
Travel smoothly throughout the itinerary with pre-arranged transfers, ensuring a seamless and hassle-free holiday from arrival to departure.
Stay at One Farrer Hotel, offering a luxury experience with modern amenities, spacious rooms, and excellent connectivity at a value-for-money price.
overview:
About the Tour:
Experience the best of Singapore on a perfectly curated journey blending iconic landmarks and thrilling attractions. Begin with arrival and an unforgettable evening at Night Safari Singapore with a guided tram ride, wildlife encounters, and the Ulu Ulu buffet dinner. Explore city highlights like Merlion Park, Marina Bay Sands SkyPark, and Gardens by the Bay with Cloud Forest, Flower Dome & Jurassic World. Enjoy Express Pass access at Universal Studios Singapore, scenic views via the Singapore Cable Car, and marine wonders at the Singapore Oceanarium, and conclude with Wings of Time and a fun day at Adventure Cove Waterpark.

know_before_you_go: No bill will be reimbursed against any missed service/facility.
International/ domestic flights are not included in the package price.
Visa assistance will be provided but the price is not included in the package.
Please carry valid IDs and Thrillophilia Voucher.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
Please do not litter and keep destination clean.
The activities and tickets included in the package are non-refundable in case of cancellation.
The dates for the activities cannot be changed as the number of visitors at some places are limited. The traveller have to pay an additional cost for the activities incase of rescheduling.
According to the Singapore govt. It is mandatory to buy a travel insurance

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore | Singapore Night Safari Experience
days.desc: Welcome to the Lion City, Singapore! Upon arrival, get transferred to your hotel and check in. In the evening, get driven to explore the world’s first nocturnal wildlife park, the Singapore Night Safari. Once there, discover over 2,500 animals in recreated habitats, enjoy a 45-minute tram ride spotting tigers, lions, and fishing cats, and witness entertaining animal shows. Also, savor a delicious Ulu Ulu Indian buffet dinner, making for an unforgettable evening of wildlife and adventure.

days.title: Singapore Sightseeing Tour | Visit to Marina Bay Sands Sky Park  & Gardens by the Bay
days.desc: Begin your day with a Singapore city tour covering the city’s most iconic landmarks. Wander through the lively streets of Chinatown, capture photos at the famous Merlion overlooking Marina Bay, and admire the futuristic design of the Helix Bridge with views of the Singapore Flyer. Next, ascend Marina Bay Sands SkyPark for breathtaking 360° skyline views & visit the Gardens by the Bay, exploring the misty Cloud Forest, vibrant Flower Dome, and the immersive Jurassic World experience.

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to Universal Studios Singapore, Southeast Asia’s only Hollywood-themed park. Once there, explore seven immersive zones, from the ancient wonders of Egypt to the futuristic Sci-Fi City. Enjoy adrenaline-pumping rides like Battlestar Galactica and Transformers, watch spectacular live shows, and meet your favorite movie characters. With a mix of cinematic adventures, family-friendly attractions, and exciting experiences, the park promises nonstop fun for everyone.

days.title: Sentosa Island Day Tour with Singapore Cable Car | Singapore Oceanarium | Wings of Time
days.desc: Today, get driven to Universal Studios Singapore & from there head to Imbiah Station for scenic ride on the Singapore Cable Car, offering aerial views of Sentosa Island. Once there, head to Singapore Oceanarium, where you’ll explore vast underwater habitats featuring over 100,000 marine animals, walk through immersive tunnel galleries, & witness diverse ecosystems from coral reefs to open oceans. Conclude your day with the spectacular Wings of Time show, blending water, laser, and fire effects.

days.title: Visit to Adventure Cove Waterpark
days.desc: Today, get driven to Adventure Cove Waterpark, where fun meets adventure. Once there, slide down thrilling water rides, float along the lazy river, and snorkel with colorful tropical fish in the Rainbow Reef. Experience adrenaline-pumping attractions or relax in the wave pool while soaking up the sun. With activities for all ages, Adventure Cove offers an exciting blend of aquatic thrills, family fun, and unforgettable memories in the heart of Sentosa Island.

days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel and get driven to the airport for your departure flight. As you leave Singapore, carry with you unforgettable memories of its iconic skyline, world-class attractions, lush gardens, thrilling experiences, and vibrant culture—bringing your incredible journey to a memorable close.
